statements.proposition: Removing the multiapi code, tooling and options in this change is backward-compatible.
statements.label: FALSE
statements.note: The change removes public surface: the 'multiapi_combiner' console-script entry point in eng/tools/azure-sdk-tools/pyproject.toml, the multiapi_combiner template directory (leaving multiapi_combiner.py in the tree, still referencing the deleted templates path), the 'is_multiapi' keyword of change_log_generate, and the 'multiapi' autorest option in swagger_to_sdk_config_v4.json. Anyone invoking the removed script or option is broken, so 'backward-compatible' does not hold in the plain sense. In-repo callers of is_multiapi: none found at head (sdk_generator.py already had no multiapi references at base), so the internal pipeline is unaffected; external users unknown. Also the message's claims about sdk_generator.py edits and a 958-line deletion do not match the change list (multiapi_combiner.py and sdk_generator.py are not in it).
evidence: change list: 9 files removed under packaging_tools/templates/multiapi_combiner/; multiapi_combiner.py not in change list and still contains PackageLoader('packaging_tools','templates/multiapi_combiner') at head
